A slim, light backpack that carries your laptop and daily essentials without the bulk.

Outdated, bulky backpacks ruin a professional look. This sleek, structured design keeps its shape no matter how full it is, helping you look sharp and stay organised for work, business, or travel.

A hidden back pocket keeps your passport, wallet or phone against your back, away from pickpockets in busy stations and streets.

products.title: Men’s Work Backpack – Water-Resistant Laptop & Business Bag

description.plain:
Built for professional routines

This men’s work backpack is designed to support busy professional days, from daily commuting to meetings and business travel. Its clean lines and structured profile offer a discreet, professional appearance suitable for office environments.

Secure and convenient flap closure

The front flap provides convenient access to the main compartment while helping keep your belongings securely enclosed during everyday use. Its streamlined design complements the backpack’s clean, professional appearance.

Organized interior for work essentials

Inside, the backpack provides a well-structured layout designed to carry a laptop, documents, and everyday accessories. Multiple internal pockets help keep items separated and easy to access throughout the day.

Water-resistant exterior and comfortable carry

Made from water-resistant PU material, the exterior is designed to help light rain bead and roll off the surface during everyday use. The backpack is water-resistant, not waterproof, and is not designed to provide complete protection against heavy rain, prolonged exposure to water, or immersion.

Adjustable, ergonomic shoulder straps ensure comfortable wear during workdays and daily commutes.

Explore more options in our men’s work backpacks collection.

products.title: KROSER 17.3 Inch USB Laptop Backpack for Work Travel

description.plain:
Description

USB laptop backpack for work travel, commuting, and organized daily carry

The KROSER 17.3" Large Laptop Backpack with USB Charging Port is designed for commuters, professionals, students, and travelers who need practical storage with convenient charging access. This USB laptop backpack fits most laptops up to 17.3 inches and combines padded laptop protection, spacious multi-compartment storage, water-repellent polyester, ergonomic padded shoulder straps, and a luggage strap for work, business trips, travel, and everyday carry.

Built for users who carry more than a laptop, this 17.3 inch laptop backpack provides organized space for documents, chargers, cables, accessories, notebooks, travel items, and daily essentials. The spacious multi-compartment layout helps separate your belongings clearly, making it easier to find what you need during commutes, office days, school routines, or short trips.

The built-in USB charging port gives you convenient access to phone charging when connected to your own power bank inside the backpack. This makes the bag useful for long workdays, campus schedules, business travel, and daily movement between home, office, school, and transportation stops. The padded laptop compartment helps protect your device from everyday bumps while keeping it easy to access.

Made with water-repellent polyester, this large laptop backpack is built for dependable daily performance. The ergonomic padded shoulder straps support comfortable carrying during longer use, while the luggage strap allows the backpack to slide over a rolling suitcase handle for easier travel. Its clean and functional design works well for commuting, business trips, office use, school, and everyday carry.

Whether you need a backpack for a 17.3 inch laptop, a USB laptop backpack for commuting, or a large work backpack with organized storage, this KROSER backpack balances capacity, protection, comfort, and daily convenience in one practical design.

Features

  • Fits most laptops up to 17.3 inches with padded protection
  • Spacious multi-compartment design for organized storage
  • Built-in USB charging port for convenient charging with your own power bank
  • Water-repellent polyester for dependable everyday use
  • Durable construction for commuting, work, school, and travel routines
  • Eronomic padded shoulder straps support long-lasting carrying comfort
  • Luggage strap allows easy attachment to rolling suitcases
  • Clean functional design for business trips, commuting, and daily carry

Specifications

  • Laptop Compatibility: Up to 17.3 inches
  • Dimensions: 18.5" × 13.3" × 7.8"
  • Weight: 2.64 lbs
  • Material: Water-repellent polyester
  • Structure: Large USB laptop backpack with multi-compartment storage
  • Charging Feature: Built-in USB charging port for use with your own power bank or power source
  • Best For: commuting, business trips, travel, school, office use, and everyday carry

Care Instructions

Wipe the backpack gently with a soft damp cloth and allow it to air dry fully before storage. Do not machine wash, bleach, iron, soak, or expose the backpack to sharp surfaces for long periods. Store it in a cool, dry place when not in use to help maintain the water-repellent polyester material, zippers, straps, USB port area, compartments, and overall structure.

Warranty

KROSER offers a limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. If you need assistance, please contact our customer support team with your order information.

FAQ

Q: What makes this backpack useful for daily commuting?
A: The backpack includes padded laptop protection, spacious compartments, ergonomic shoulder straps, and a built-in USB charging port, making it practical for commuting, office work, school, and daily carry.

Q: Can this backpack fit a 17.3 inch laptop?
A: Yes. The padded laptop compartment is designed to fit most laptops up to 17.3 inches. Please compare your laptop dimensions with the backpack size before ordering.

Q: Does the USB charging port include a power bank?
A: No. The USB charging port is designed to connect with your own power bank or power source inside the backpack.

Q: Is this backpack comfortable for longer carrying times?
A: Yes. The ergonomic padded shoulder straps help support carrying comfort during commutes, school days, work routines, and short travel.

Q: Is this backpack suitable for business trips?
A: Yes. The large storage layout, padded laptop compartment, luggage strap, and organized compartments make it suitable for business trips, commuting, office use, and everyday travel.

Care Instructions

Wipe the backpack gently with a soft damp cloth and allow it to air dry fully before storage. Do not machine wash, bleach, iron, soak, or expose the backpack to sharp surfaces for long periods. Store it in a cool, dry place when not in use to help maintain the water-repellent polyester material, zippers, straps, USB port area, compartments, and overall structure.

Q: Does the USB charging port include a power bank?

Q: Is this backpack comfortable for longer carrying times?

Q: Is this backpack suitable for business trips?
A: Yes. The large storage layout, padded laptop compartment, luggage strap, and organized compartments make it suitable for business trips, commuting, office use, and everyday travel.
